_design: SHAPE-CHANGING RHYTHM (user principle: every gimmick must force a leg-shape change). The required leg cycles SHORT(tunnel) → LONG(gap/planks) → HOOK(stairs) so the player redraws at almost every beat. STAIRS are HOOK-GATED (hookGate:true, DECOUPLED from slope): a flat/long leg slips & jams at the foot, only a HOOK grips the step edges & climbs. The risers are kept GENTLE (0.5u) so the body does NOT have to float to clear the spinning leg's forward sweep — the cube STEPS tread-by-tread (its stand level tracks the tread directly under it, eased = 한 칸씩, hook legs visibly catching each step) instead of sliding up the hypotenuse (the user's repeated complaint). balls/blocks/bumps are no-gate TEXTURE breathers between forcing gimmicks. Each stairs run is paired with a matched DOWN ramp so the vertical profile stays bounded.

segments._note: START lead-in — run straight, draw the first leg.
SHORT — low ceiling; a long leg's sweep strikes it, must draw a short leg.
LONG — leap the V-trench; a short leg drops in and crawls (slow).

STAIRS climb — HOOK-gated (계단형). riser 0.5u / run ~1.08u. hookGate:true forces a HOOK shape (decoupled from slope): a flat/long leg SLIPS & jams at the foot, only a hook GRIPS the step edges & climbs. GENTLE riser (0.5) keeps the body from floating to clear the leg's forward sweep, so the cube STEPS tread-by-tread (the body's stand level tracks the tread directly under it, eased = 한 칸씩) with the hook legs visibly catching each step — NOT a smooth slide up the hypotenuse. Climb only on the tread face.
recovery DOWN ramp (slope 0.4, descending ⇒ NOT gated). Matched to the stairs rise so the vertical profile stays bounded.
ICE gimmick REMOVED per user request — was a slippery 'ice' segment; replaced with flat (same length) so the course/finishX is unchanged. Ice engine code kept dormant.
